talks.speaker: Mizuki
talks.body:
How is it, K?
I tried out all of your suggestions and tried to fix up the ending...

talks.speaker: Kanade
talks.body: Right...

talks.speaker: Kanade
talks.body: The video syncs up with the chorus much better now. Let's go with this.

talks.speaker: Mizuki
talks.body:
Yay!
Totally worth pulling that all-nighter!

talks.speaker: Ena
talks.body:
*Sigh*
I'm just glad we managed to figure everything out...

talks.speaker: Mizuki
talks.body: And thanks for helping me edit everything towards the end there, Enanan!

talks.speaker: Ena
talks.body: Now I feel sleep deprived now because of that... Make sure to get some real sleep in tonight, Amia.

talks.speaker: Mizuki
talks.body:
I will.
I'll start by sleeping in until noon!

talks.speaker: Kanade
talks.body: Anyway, this means our song and music video are both done.

talks.speaker: Mizuki
talks.body: (We finally get to upload it. The song that made Mafuyu smile...)

talks.speaker: Mizuki
talks.body: (She and Kanade put so much effort into this song too...)

talks.speaker: Mizuki
talks.body: I hope this gets a ton of views!

talks.speaker: Mafuyu
talks.body: Me too...

talks.speaker: Kanade
talks.body: You too, Yuki?

talks.speaker: Mafuyu
talks.body: It's better than nobody seeing it.

talks.speaker: Kanade
talks.body: Right.

talks.speaker: Mizuki
talks.body: Hehe...

talks.speaker: Kanade
talks.body: Okay, I'm uploading it now.

talks.speaker: Ena
talks.body: Hehe. I can't wait to see what people say about it, but I should probably hit the hay now... *Yawn*...

talks.speaker: Kanade
talks.body:
Great work, everyone.
This took a lot out of us, so we should all get some well-deserved rest.

talks.speaker: Mafuyu
talks.body:
Okay...
Good night.

talks.speaker: Ena
talks.body:
Night.
Oh, I think I'll take a bath first...

talks.speaker: Mizuki
talks.body: Night, everyone!

talks.speaker: Mizuki
talks.body:
Mhm...
Man, I slept great...!

talks.speaker: Mizuki
talks.body: But I still feel really drowsy. I guess I did stay up pretty late last night.

talks.speaker: Mizuki
talks.body:
Oh, it's 10:00...?
I don't have school or work today, so I can go back to... Wait!

talks.speaker: Mizuki
talks.body:
Our new song!
What are people saying about it?

talks.speaker: Mizuki
talks.body: Huh?! It has this many views already?! In less than half a day...?

talks.speaker: Comment
talks.body: N25's new song's amazing!

talks.speaker: Comment
talks.body: I didn't know they could make music like this.

talks.speaker: Comment
talks.body: I've had a lot on my mind lately, but I feel way better after hearing this song.

talks.speaker: Mizuki
talks.body:
(Thank goodness...
It's reaching everyone.)

talks.speaker: Mizuki
talks.body: (The others really put everything they had into this song, so I couldn't be happier.)

talks.speaker: Mizuki
talks.body: (Especially Kanade... She really is an incredible person...)

talks.speaker: Mizuki
talks.body: (It all started with Mafuyu saying, “This isn't good enough.” And now, she's found a way to reach not just Mafuyu, but all these other people...)

talks.speaker: Mizuki
talks.body: (It's not just Kanade either. Mafuyu and Ena are also really amazing people.)

talks.speaker: Mizuki
talks.body: (They're taking a hard look at themselves and facing their problems despite how uncomfortable that might be.)

talks.speaker: Mizuki
talks.body: (But look at me...)

talks.speaker: Mizuki
talks.body: (I haven't changed at all.)

talks.speaker: Mizuki
talks.body: (I'm still stuck in the same place...)

talks.speaker: Mizuki
talks.body: Huh? A message? At this time?

talks.speaker: Ena
talks.body: You awake? Did you see the view count?

talks.speaker: Mizuki
talks.body:
Oh, it's Ena...
She's awake already?

talks.speaker: Mizuki
talks.body: <Yeah, I saw! Isn't it awesome?! It's like double what we usually get!> And send...

talks.speaker: Ena
talks.body: Everyone's saying that the video goes really well with the music, so this one might end up becoming our best one yet, you know?

talks.speaker: Mizuki
talks.body:
Yeah!
I hope K and Yuki get to enjoy this too!

talks.speaker: Ena
talks.body: This also means we should pick a date to do an after party. When are you gonna be free, Amia?

talks.speaker: Mizuki
talks.body: Oh...

talks.speaker: Mizuki
talks.body: My work schedule hasn't been decided yet, but I should know sometime this week. I'll let you know when I find out.

talks.speaker: Ena
talks.body:
Okay.
I'll ask K and Yuki in the meantime.

talks.speaker: Mizuki
talks.body: (An after party...)

talks.speaker: Mizuki
talks.body: (I want to go, but...)

talks.speaker: Ena
talks.body: You're coming, right?

talks.speaker: Ena
talks.body: These things aren't as fun when you're not there.

talks.speaker: Mizuki
talks.body: Ena...

talks.speaker: Mizuki
talks.body: Yeah, I'll be there.

talks.speaker: Mizuki
talks.body: Poor, lonely Ena♪

talks.speaker: Mizuki
talks.body:
Haha...
Yup, she's mad.

talks.speaker: Mizuki
talks.body:
But Ena really is a good person...
I mean, she's willing to put up with me like this.

talks.speaker: Mizuki
talks.body: (I know that I haven't made any progress up until now...)

talks.speaker: Mizuki
talks.body: (But I hope that I'll become closer with them, someday...)
